_comment: Inline policy for the per-space instance role ikigenba-space-<name>. The operator-side tool substitutes five literal placeholders at create time; Terraform never reads this file. <name> is the space name (its SSM path /ikigenba/<name>/* and its bucket prefix <name>/). <domain> is the space's domain, by default <name>.<account domain> where the account domain is the `domain` property at /ikigenba/account; the space's records are <domain> and *.<domain>. <zone_id> is the hosted zone found by longest-suffix match of <domain> over the account's hosted zones. <account_id> is the account the space is created in. <bucket> is the account's backup bucket, the `backup_bucket` property at /ikigenba/account; the role's permissions boundary ARN is the `permissions_boundary_arn` property there. The boundary is the ceiling: nothing granted here can exceed it.
